title: Portuguese conquest of Viye
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Portuguese conquest of Viye", at revision 1370704793, opens: "The Portuguese Conquest of the Kingdom of Viye was a military operation in 1890 and it was part of the Portuguese Campaigns of Pacification and Occupation that resulted in the formation of modern-day Angola." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q135276043, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1890 conquest". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
